title: Biss Jaggery Modak
hookLine: Global-inspired biss jaggery modak with 3 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Take the grated coconut in a bowl. 2. Add jaggery to the grated coconut. Line your chilling pan or tray with parchment paper for easy lifting, and keep {m53580_1}, {m53580_2}, and {m53580_3} measured and ready to combine.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure coconut flakes first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix the coconut and jaggery thoroughly until they are evenly combined. 4. Take small portions of the mixture and shape them into modaks using your hands or a modak mould.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {m53580_3} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Slice & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Repeat until all the mixture has been used. 6. Serve the freshly prepared jaggery coconut modaks. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
